title: Meet.jobs Service Closure Announcement
text: Meet.jobs Service Closure Announcement Thank You Meet.jobs 2014 – 2026 Connecting Talent Beyond Borders Since 2014 ◎ 160+ Countries ♢ 1,000+ Successful Hires ○ 300,000+ Tech Talents ✦ 服務停止公告 Meet.jobs 已於 2026 年 6 月 30 日正式停止網站服務。 自 2014 年成立以來，Meet.jobs 已累積超過 300,000 名來自全球 160 多個國家的用戶，並協助超過 1,000 位人才成功錄取新工作。 我們衷心感謝所有求職者、推薦人、企業夥伴與支持者，陪伴 Meet.jobs 走過這段旅程。 Service Closure Announcement Meet.jobs officially ceased website operations on June 30, 2026. Since our founding in 2014, Meet.jobs has served more than 300,000 users from over 160 countries and helped more than 1,000 professionals successfully land new opportunities. We sincerely thank all candidates, referrers, employers, partners, and supporters who have been part of this journey. ◇ 用戶資料保護 Data Protection 所有用戶履歷、應徵紀錄及相關資料，將依照適用法規及隱私保護原則妥善保存與管理。 All user profiles, applications, and related data will be retained and protected in accordance with applicable laws and privacy regulations. □ 推薦獎金與後續服務 Referral Rewards & Ongoing Support 若您於 2026 年 6 月 30 日前透過 Meet.jobs 成功錄取，或成功推薦人才錄取，相關推薦獎金權益仍然有效。 我們將持續提供相關確認與獎金發放服務至： 2026 年 12 月 31 日 If a successful hire or referral was made through Meet.jobs before June 30, 2026, eligible referral reward
